notes: Statuses are per row. Not every older pattern is officially deprecated; target validation remains necessary.

items.caveat: Luau is not a full superset of later Lua; do not import filesystem/package APIs into Studio.

items.new: task.wait or an event driven design
items.caveat: Do not preserve a polling loop unnecessarily; task.wait is not an exact timer.

items.new: Choose task.defer or task.spawn by scheduling intent
items.caveat: Legacy delayed scheduling is not identical to immediate task.spawn.

items.new: task.delay with owner and cancellation policy
items.caveat: A scheduled callback can outlive character/UI; do not rely only on nominal delay.

items.old: a and b or c ternary
items.new: if a then b else c
items.caveat: False/nil b differs from desired true branch semantics.
Dictionary order remains unsuitable for deterministic algorithms.
Current math predicates have an isolated feature probe; portable predicate also provided.

items.new: Binding immutability plus explicit ownership/freeze strategy
items.caveat: Nested contents can still mutate; probe target parser.
:: and --!strict do not perform runtime checks.

items.new: Narrow unknown; local interfaces and tagged unions
items.caveat: Use escape hatches only with isolated rationale; do not mute entire modules.

items.new: Explicit copy depth and alias contract
items.caveat: Clone is shallow; cyclic graphs need an explicit policy.

items.new: Freeze only documented boundary; preserve nested ownership
items.caveat: Shallow table freeze does not freeze Instances or nested tables.
Do not import TypeScript syntax; probe actual parser.

items.new: Profile hot numeric code; file/function directive where supported
items.caveat: @native does not recursively mark inner functions; no universal speedup.

items.old: if local/exact tables as universal baseline
items.new: Treat current upstream experiments as gated
items.caveat: Merged/release source is not universal Studio support.

items.new: Script with RunContext Client or a valid LocalScript container
items.caveat: LocalScript remains supported; class and placement both matter.

items.old: Client Script copied into every starter root
items.new: One intentional entrypoint and correct host
items.caveat: Avoid both original and clone startup where applicable.
Replicated containers are visible to clients.

items.new: RemoteEvent request/ack where non-blocking semantics fit
items.caveat: RemoteFunction is not deprecated universally; avoid server critical path waiting on client.

items.new: Client intent, server computes and validates
items.caveat: Validate state, identity, timing and target independently.
Client UI feedback is not enforcement.
A replicated exploiter-controlled position can pass naive distance checks.

items.new: Choose reliable transitions vs lossy samples
items.caveat: Unreliable samples cannot carry sole economy or guaranteed state transitions.
Do not depend on an undocumented ordering guarantee.
Instance can stream out later; timeout is not permission to invent placeholder state.
A bounded audit pass is not the same as hot-loop scanning.

items.old: Actors make all API writes thread-safe
items.new: Read thread safety per member; serial commit
items.caveat: ReadSafe is not parallel write permission.
Coroutines and concurrent tasks are not proof of CPU parallel speedup.

items.old: old ray helpers for new code
items.caveat: Direction includes range magnitude; check returned nil and filters.

items.old: body mover chosen by an old tutorial
items.caveat: Do not substitute force/velocity/position constraints without matching physical intent.
Do not overwrite a valid stored profile with defaults after a failed read.

items.old: last retry may write older state
items.caveat: Independent retry loops can reorder writes.
Callback can execute more than once; irreversible effects need a separate durable protocol.
Client completion is not authoritative purchase fulfillment.
TTL/expiry must be tolerated; not a replacement for DataStore.
Design for duplicates/late events; no invented exactly-once guarantee.
Full test needs published Roblox client, not Studio alone.

items.old: raw user text fallback if filter fails
items.new: Safe pending/error UI; current filter API
items.caveat: Do not publish unfiltered text on service errors.

items.new: LightingStyle + PrioritizeLightingQuality after exact permission check
items.caveat: Current YAML says new members write None; Technology RobloxScriptSecurity.

items.new: Check security and required Studio setup
items.caveat: pcall catches denial; it does not grant rights.

items.old: PBR has only four relevant maps
items.caveat: Emissive is included; supported behavior and mutability still need checking.

items.old: every texture map freely mutable at runtime
items.caveat: Color tint support is different from replacing texture maps.

items.new: Use material reference and compare real response
items.caveat: Do not compensate wrong roughness with fake Bloom.
Separate asset IDs can prevent intended batching; verify actual render statistics.

items.old: SLIM works in any unsaved local file
items.caveat: No claim of successful cloud transcoding without a real result.
Readability and low-tier performance are acceptance criteria.

items.old: Sound is the only audio architecture
items.caveat: Legacy working audio need not be rewritten without a reason.

items.new: InputAction and device bindings where appropriate
items.caveat: Touch UI and modal priorities still require implementation.
Do not generate unsupported CSS properties/selectors.

items.old: all movement requires hardcoded Humanoid state overrides
items.caveat: Do not enable CCL blindly on an existing game.

items.old: animation graph is just a local table
items.caveat: Preview and published support/authority mode differ.

items.old: script sync backs up every scene property
items.new: Sync supported code roots; preserve separate metadata/place
items.caveat: Tags/attributes and arbitrary instances are not a complete disk backup.

items.old: generated model can mutate any Workspace child
items.caveat: Avoid irreversible side effects during cancellable generation.
Procedural assets can modify a place while editing.

items.old: all supported API is automatically available in a sandbox
items.new: Inspect exact capability and nesting contract
items.caveat: Nested capability sets do not grant extra parent rights.

items.new: Real MicroProfiler / Scene Analysis / device evidence
items.caveat: SceneAudit helper explicitly does not measure draw calls.
Track spikes and separate CPU/GPU/bottleneck evidence.

items.new: Progressive local retrieval + full relevant subsection
items.caveat: Index count is not file download count or measured model improvement.
